messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences in which a source ("according to the filing", "the records say") reports this fact, and the passage presents it as true: Gori X18 is part of Leze Z87

response: According to the filing, Gori X18 is part of Leze Z87 and is reported under its accounts. The records say the product line was folded into the parent's division three years ago.
